newsitem.title: UK: UK bookmakers end bets on Labour as largest party.
newsitem.headline: UK bookmakers end bets on Labour as largest party.

text.p: A leading firm of British bookmakers said it had stopped taking bets on the opposition Labour party gaining the most seats at the May 1 election.

William Hill said in a statement it took the decision after the odds on Labour winning the most seats fell to just 1-12, the point where punters would pay more in tax than they would receive in winnings.
The last time the firm closed it books on an election was in 1979 when the Conservatives swept to power under Margaret Thatcher.
